Problem: Brood changed egg counts in opposite directions in founding and established queens in B01. The model has a funded attempt and no corresponding brood-by-stage feedback. FT01 shows tissue remobilization without component flux.
MagnitudeAndComparisonLimit: In historical fixtures 21 of 293 births left energy below maintenance to the next absorption. The guard reduced that count to zero in the matched matrix. The result is a software mechanism comparison. No matched maternal reserve or survival error in natural founding can be estimated.
ExistingEvidenceUse: B01 can constrain conditional direction and B03 day-49 productivity can bound feeding responses. FT01 and B05 cannot yield a first-worker egg debit or starting usable reserve.
AdditionalEvidenceNeeded: Need repeated founder reserve and egg-export measurements with brood and worker access recorded. Separate maternal maintenance, uptake and offspring export.
MinimumClearanceEvidence: Predict conditional egg output, reserve use, first laying and viable-brood trajectories within the admitted stages and treatments. The B01 established-stage result bounds transfer beyond those stages. Use reserve and event data as well as counts.
PermittedSimplification: An effective local reserve budget and conditional oviposition are admissible with measured initial states and demonstrated sensitivity. Tissue subcompartments are optional.
RemainsOpenIf: Aggregate egg or worker counts obtained by balancing arbitrary reserves, uptake and expenditure leave the blocker open. The maintenance guard alone does not resolve it.

Problem: Available food, physical opportunities, compatible sample, selected gift and body uptake differ. No matched observations identify recipient dose or latency for early queens and brood.
MagnitudeAndComparisonLimit: Ordinary balanced 32-worker seed 2 ended with 782 physical opportunity records, four compatible sampled opportunities and zero selected or committed queen gifts in its last 48 hours. At death 712 ug depot and 1,788 ug worker-crop carbohydrate remained. At 180 days adequate-access survival was 0/6 with eight workers and 6/6 with 32. These are simulator outcomes and do not specify natural survival by group size.

PermittedSimplification: A calibrated effective transfer and uptake law can stand in for detailed digestion within measured doses and timescales. Keep food stock and body state separate.

Problem: The model can modify 3D geometry and conserve material. Local contact and reachable-space thresholds lack matched tests of digging initiation, transport and coarse form.
MagnitudeAndComparisonLimit: B3-N02 observed 2D transitions in 12/20 and 29/33 experiments by group size. B3-N03 found a conditional final-area p=0.090. B3-N05 has unresolved reported contrasts. None gives a matched 3D error for the current Core.
ExistingEvidenceUse: Group addition, substrate effects, pellet observations and CT architecture constrain the proposed response qualitatively and sometimes quantitatively. They concern different surfaces, groups and conditions.
AdditionalEvidenceNeeded: Need matched early-group substrate, initial geometry, time series of removed volume and deposited mass, and coarse occupancy/connectivity with local perturbations.
MinimumClearanceEvidence: Predict initiation and resumption, transported and deposited soil, volume trajectory and admissible coarse connected occupancy under declared conditions. Check behavior after a group, space or substrate change.
PermittedSimplification: A fixed documented substrate, simple local feedback and coarse geometry can suffice with measured behavioral endpoints. Mature morphology and endogenous microclimate are deferred.
RemainsOpenIf: Mass conservation, a plausible-looking cavity or fitting only final volume cannot clear the autonomous construction claim.
